title: order.rejected
description: The engine refused the order. A rejection is a persisted order, not an error, and it occupies its client_order_id.

reason.description: Why the engine refused the order. Known values: invalid_order, invalid_price_tick, invalid_qty_step, below_min_notional, above_max_qty, duplicate_order_id, empty_book, quote_qty_too_small, market_not_active, insufficient_balance, account_frozen, policy_denied. Left open on purpose: a new reason is an addition, not a breaking change.

seq.description: Null when the order was refused before it reached the book.
